cases.name: save and load trace snapshot
cases.execute: const ts = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); const fs = await import("fs"); const dir = $root+"/packages/main/tests/fixtures"; const trace = [{fn:"test",file:"t.ts",line:1,children:[]}]; ts.saveTraceSnapshot(dir,"_test-trace-store","case1",trace,$root); const loaded = ts.loadTraceSnapshot(dir,"_test-trace-store","case1"); const ok = !!(loaded && loaded.trace[0].fn==="test" && loaded.commit && loaded.timestamp); try{fs.unlinkSync(dir+"/_test-trace-store.trace.json")}catch{} return ok

cases.name: trace snapshot overwrite update
cases.execute: const ts = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); const fs = await import("fs"); const dir = $root+"/packages/main/tests/fixtures"; ts.saveTraceSnapshot(dir,"_test-overwrite","c1",[{fn:"v1",file:"f",line:1,children:[]}],$root); ts.saveTraceSnapshot(dir,"_test-overwrite","c1",[{fn:"v2",file:"f",line:1,children:[]}],$root); const s = ts.loadTraceSnapshot(dir,"_test-overwrite","c1"); const ok = s && s.trace[0].fn==="v2"; try{fs.unlinkSync(dir+"/_test-overwrite.trace.json")}catch{} return ok

cases.name: empty trace array saved
cases.execute: const ts = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); const fs = await import("fs"); const dir = $root+"/packages/main/tests/fixtures"; ts.saveTraceSnapshot(dir,"_test-empty","c1",[],$root); const s = ts.loadTraceSnapshot(dir,"_test-empty","c1"); const ok = s && Array.isArray(s.trace) && s.trace.length===0; try{fs.unlinkSync(dir+"/_test-empty.trace.json")}catch{} return ok

cases.name: auto create fixtures dir
cases.execute: const ts = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); const fs = await import("fs"); const dir = $root+"/packages/main/tests/fixtures/_subdir_test"; ts.saveTraceSnapshot(dir,"test","c1",[{fn:"x",file:"f",line:1,children:[]}],$root); const ok = fs.existsSync(dir+"/test.trace.json"); try{fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true})}catch{} return ok

cases.name: special chars in case name
cases.execute: const ts = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); const fs = await import("fs"); const dir = $root+"/packages/main/tests/fixtures"; ts.saveTraceSnapshot(dir,"_test-special","case with spaces & 中文",[{fn:"x",file:"f",line:1,children:[]}],$root); const s = ts.loadTraceSnapshot(dir,"_test-special","case with spaces & 中文"); const ok = s && s.caseName==="case with spaces & 中文"; try{fs.unlinkSync(dir+"/_test-special.trace.json")}catch{} return ok

cases.name: corrupt trace json ignored
cases.execute: const ts = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); const fs = await import("fs"); const dir = $root+"/packages/main/tests/fixtures"; fs.writeFileSync(dir+"/_test-corrupt.trace.json","not json"); const s = ts.loadTraceSnapshot(dir,"_test-corrupt","c1"); try{fs.unlinkSync(dir+"/_test-corrupt.trace.json")}catch{} return s === null

cases.name: write fail no crash
cases.execute: const ts = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); try { ts.saveTraceSnapshot("/nonexistent/path","test","c1",[{fn:"x",file:"f",line:1,children:[]}],$root); } catch(e) { return true; } return true

cases.name: concurrent write safe
cases.execute: const ts = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); const fs = await import("fs"); const dir = $root+"/packages/main/tests/fixtures"; const p1 = ts.saveTraceSnapshot(dir,"_test-conc","c1",[{fn:"a",file:"f",line:1,children:[]}],$root); const p2 = ts.saveTraceSnapshot(dir,"_test-conc","c2",[{fn:"b",file:"f",line:1,children:[]}],$root); const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(dir+"/_test-conc.trace.json","utf-8")); const ok = data.snapshots && Object.keys(data.snapshots).length >= 1; try{fs.unlinkSync(dir+"/_test-conc.trace.json")}catch{} return ok

cases.name: setup: clean test traces
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const traceDir = path.join($root, ".koala", "traces"); try { fs.rmSync(path.join(traceDir, "test-CHK.trace.json"), {force:true}); } catch {} return "cleaned"

cases.name: CHK-002: saveTraceSnapshot writes to .koala/traces/
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root, "test-CHK.json", "case-a", [{fn:"foo",file:"bar.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); return "saved"

cases.name: CHK-002: loadTraceSnapshot reads from .koala/traces/
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); const snap = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root, "test-CHK.json", "case-a"); return snap && snap.caseName === "case-a" && snap.trace[0].fn === "foo"

cases.name: CHK-002: trace survives git restore
cases.execute: const {execSync} = await import("node:child_process"); try { execSync("git restore .", {cwd:$root,stdio:"pipe"}); } catch {} const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); const snap = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root, "test-CHK.json", "case-a"); return snap !== null && snap.caseName === "case-a"

cases.name: CHK-002: mkdirSync auto-creates .koala/traces/
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const subDir = path.join($root, ".koala", "traces", "sub"); try { fs.rmSync(path.join(subDir), {recursive:true,force:true}); } catch {} const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root, "sub/nested.json", "case-x", [{fn:"bar",file:"x.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); const snap = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root, "sub/nested.json", "case-x"); try { fs.rmSync(path.join(subDir), {recursive:true,force:true}); } catch {} return snap !== null

cases.name: CHK-002: Windows backslash path handled
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"sub\win-test.json","wc",[{fn:"w",file:"w.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); const snap = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"sub\win-test.json","wc"); const traceFile = path.join($root,".koala","traces","sub","win-test.trace.json"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} try{fs.rmdirSync(path.join($root,".koala","traces","sub"));}catch{} return snap !== null && snap.caseName==="wc"

cases.name: CHK-002: partial corrupt trace still loads
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"test-corrupt.json","good",[{fn:"g",file:"g.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); const traceFile = path.join($root,".koala","traces","test-corrupt.trace.json"); const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(traceFile,"utf-8")); data.snapshots["bad"] = "not-an-object"; fs.writeFileSync(traceFile, JSON.stringify(data)); const snap = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"test-corrupt.json","good"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} return snap !== null && snap.trace[0].fn==="g"

cases.name: CHK-002: Windows backslash path
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"sub/win-test.json","wc",[{fn:"w",file:"w.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); const snap = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"sub/win-test.json","wc"); const traceFile = path.join($root,".koala","traces","sub","win-test.trace.json"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} try{fs.rmdirSync(path.join($root,".koala","traces","sub"));}catch{} return snap !== null && snap.caseName==="wc"

cases.name: CHK-003: same commit dedup overwrites
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const traceFile = path.join($root,".koala","traces","test-dedup.trace.json"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"test-dedup.json","dd",[{fn:"first",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[]}]); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"test-dedup.json","dd",[{fn:"second",file:"a.ts",line:2,children:[]}]); const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(traceFile,"utf-8")); const keys = Object.keys(raw.snapshots).filter(k=>k.startsWith("dd:")||k==="dd"); const snap = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"test-dedup.json","dd"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} return keys.length===1 && snap.trace[0].fn==="second"

cases.name: CHK-003: malformed key no crash
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const traceFile = path.join($root,".koala","traces","test-malfmt.trace.json"); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(traceFile),{recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync(traceFile, JSON.stringify({snapshots:{"plain-no-colon":[{commit:"x",timestamp:"2024-01-01",caseName:"plain-no-colon",fixturePath:"t",trace:[{fn:"ok",file:"o.ts",line:1,children:[]}]}],"bad-val":"not-an-array","null-val":null}})); const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); const good = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"test-malfmt.json","plain-no-colon"); const bad = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"test-malfmt.json","bad-val"); const nul = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"test-malfmt.json","null-val"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} return good!==null && good.trace[0].fn==="ok" && bad===null && nul===null

cases.name: CHK-003: load returns newest timestamp across commits
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const traceFile = path.join($root,".koala","traces","test-newest.trace.json"); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(traceFile),{recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync(traceFile, JSON.stringify({snapshots:{"mc:abc":[{commit:"abc",timestamp:"2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",caseName:"mc",fixturePath:"test-newest.json",trace:[{fn:"old",file:"o.ts",line:1,children:[]}]}],"mc:def":[{commit:"def",timestamp:"2024-06-01T00:00:00Z",caseName:"mc",fixturePath:"test-newest.json",trace:[{fn:"new",file:"n.ts",line:2,children:[]}]}]}})); const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); const snap = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"test-newest.json","mc"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} return snap!==null && snap.trace[0].fn==="new" && snap.commit==="def"

cases.name: CHK-003: 3 different commit keys preserved
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const traceFile = path.join($root,".koala","traces","test-3keys.trace.json"); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(traceFile),{recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync(traceFile, JSON.stringify({snapshots:{"hc:aaa":[{commit:"aaa",timestamp:"2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",caseName:"hc",fixturePath:"test-3keys.json",trace:[{fn:"v1",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[]}]}],"hc:bbb":[{commit:"bbb",timestamp:"2024-02-01T00:00:00Z",caseName:"hc",fixturePath:"test-3keys.json",trace:[{fn:"v2",file:"a.ts",line:2,children:[]}]}]}})); const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"test-3keys.json","hc",[{fn:"v3",file:"a.ts",line:3,children:[]}]); const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(traceFile,"utf-8")); const keys = Object.keys(raw.snapshots).filter(k=>k.startsWith("hc:")); const snap = m.loadTraceSnapshot($root,"test-3keys.json","hc"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} return keys.length===3 && snap.trace[0].fn==="v3"

cases.name: CHK-003: 6 keys evicts oldest to keep 5
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const traceFile = path.join($root,".koala","traces","test-evict.trace.json"); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(traceFile),{recursive:true}); const snaps = {}; for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const c='c'+i; snaps['ev:'+c]=[{commit:c,timestamp:'2024-0'+(i+1)+'-01T00:00:00Z',caseName:'ev',fixturePath:'test-evict.json',trace:[{fn:'f'+i,file:'a.ts',line:i,children:[]}]}];} fs.writeFileSync(traceFile, JSON.stringify({snapshots:snaps})); const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"test-evict.json","ev",[{fn:"f5",file:"a.ts",line:5,children:[]}]); const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(traceFile,"utf-8")); const keys = Object.keys(raw.snapshots).filter(k=>k.startsWith("ev:")); const hasOldest = keys.some(k=>k==="ev:c0"); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} return keys.length===5 && !hasOldest

cases.name: CHK-003: N=1 config evicts to single entry
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const configPath = path.join($root,"koala.config.json"); const origConfig = fs.readFileSync(configPath,"utf-8"); const cfg = JSON.parse(origConfig); cfg.maxTraceSnapshots = 1; fs.writeFileSync(configPath, JSON.stringify(cfg,null,2)); const traceFile = path.join($root,".koala","traces","test-n1.trace.json"); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(traceFile),{recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync(traceFile, JSON.stringify({snapshots:{"n1:old":[{commit:"old",timestamp:"2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",caseName:"n1",fixturePath:"test-n1.json",trace:[{fn:"old",file:"a.ts",line:1,children:[]}]}]}})); try { const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); m.saveTraceSnapshot($root,"test-n1.json","n1",[{fn:"new",file:"a.ts",line:2,children:[]}]); const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(traceFile,"utf-8")); const keys = Object.keys(raw.snapshots).filter(k=>k.startsWith("n1:")); fs.writeFileSync(configPath, origConfig); try{fs.rmSync(traceFile,{force:true});}catch{} return keys.length===1 && !keys.includes("n1:old"); } catch(e) { fs.writeFileSync(configPath, origConfig); throw e; }
